warnings.message: The "ta.crossover()" call inside the conditional expression might not execute on every bar, which can cause inconsistent calculations because the function depends on historical results. For consistency, assign the call's result to a global variable and use that variable in the expression instead.

Strategies without "calc_on_every_tick = true" only calculate on confirmed chart bars. In this case, "barstate.islast" may not initially return "true" on realtime bars, as the last bar is unconfirmed until it closes. If you need to check whether a bar is the latest before it closes, enable "calc_on_every_tick" in the "strategy()" function.
